Model.tier1: 100*(DPS with Tier 1 / DPS without Tier 1 - 1); fixed talents and APL
Model.gear: 100*(scaled DPS / baseline DPS - 1); Tier 1 remains on
Model.scaling: Item and suffix stats, weapon min/max and item flat bonus damage scale; enchants, weapon speed/skill, procs, sets and external effects stay fixed. The modeled-v2 scenario has no paid hit conversion.
Model.averaging: Arithmetic mean of per-race percentage gains, equal weight per available race
Model.amplification: Mean +50% gain / (5 * mean +10% gain). 1 = linear, >1 = accelerating, <1 = flattening; negative values mean the +50% scenario loses DPS. Ratio of means, not mean of race ratios.
Model.amplificationAvailability: Unavailable if the mean +10% gain is no greater than 0.1 percentage points or its conservative 95% Monte Carlo bound.
Model.uncertainty: Conservative delta-method 95% Monte Carlo bound from marginal SEs; allows within- and between-race correlation. Not a mechanics confidence interval.
Model.interpretation: Hypothetical proportional upgrades, not stat weights or actual future items. Amplification measures finite-range curvature, not proof of exponential growth or isolated stat synergy. Caps and resource/rotation thresholds can change it. Equipped weapon DPS scales in supported Cat/Bear forms; their exact variance and conditional proc behavior retain qualifications.
